description: This file is a React component implementing a client-side interactive mind map UI for a career navigation app. It manages state, fetches data via API calls, handles view persistence, and renders the mind map with filters, details panel, and loading/error handling.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between a minimum and maximum value.

methods.name: defaultFilters
methods.description: Returns the default filters configuration for the mind map.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Provides the initial safe state for the mind map view, including pan, zoom, filters, and selected node.

methods.name: toSafeState
methods.description: Converts an arbitrary object into a validated MindmapViewState, applying defaults and sanitization.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Generates a user identifier based on personaId or defaults to 'anonymous'.
